free_tier.stated: Per-record, not per-account: '5 GB for general materials science research data, 50 GB for AiiDA databases. For larger datasets please contact us.' Records are unlimited and each gets a DOI, so this is a per-record-unlimited pattern rather than a 500 GB single-shot store.

egress.terms: Free, and unusually well-instrumented: 'Access to metadata and data files is provided over standard protocols such as HTTP and OAI-PMH.' No metering. Probe: GET /record/2026.196 -> 200, 90,945 bytes of record page.

tooling: Email self-registration with a personal work area; HTTP + OAI-PMH read; DOI minting per record; versioning of published records. AiiDA provenance integration is the native client for the 50 GB tier.
chaining: Unlimited records x 5 GB (or 50 GB for AiiDA databases). 100 records at 5 GB = 500 GB; the 50 GB AiiDA tier halves that to 10 records.
